rules.name: The Whole Amount Rule
rules.body: Keep the fee debit and its currency unit together; stack the fee row on narrow screens rather than splitting the amount.

rules.name: The Explicit Outcome Rule
rules.body: Show the accepted fee and named decision; never infer a charged, waived or refunded outcome from reservation state alone.

keyCharacteristics: Inherited teal ink, pale canvas, white containers and green actions.
Native forms and disclosures with visible loading, error and outcome copy.
Explicit fee amounts, consent and links between reservations and wallet entries.
dos: Do preserve the inherited workspace palettes, native controls and keyboard focus.
Do keep fee amounts whole and use the authored wallet SVG for reservation fee entries.
Do retain fee consent, named outcomes and reservation/wallet reference links.
donts: Don't treat local demo screenshots as staging, hardware or release acceptance.
Don't turn existing glyph icons elsewhere in the wallet into a new G6 icon convention.
Don't infer a refund or settled fee from reservation state alone.
narrative.northStar: Inherited owner and driver operating workspaces
narrative.overview: This records the implemented G6 local Operate extension: owner `ReservationPolicy`, driver `ReservationForm` fee acceptance, `DriverReservations` fee outcome, and the reservation fee/reference row in `DriverWalletPage`. Root `PRODUCT.md`, root `DESIGN.md`, and `frontend/src/features/driver/DESIGN.md` retain authority over their existing scopes. There is no new direction contract or approved composition; this record adds no redesign or product-wide identity.
